description: Register (or rotate) the caller's X25519 identity key + signed prekey + one-time-prekey pool for full X3DH E2E session establishment (kotoba-lang/org-signal's kotoba.signal.x3dh). One bundle per actor; re-registering with the SAME identityKey (prekey rotation) replaces the previous one. Re-registering with a DIFFERENT identityKey (e.g. a new device) is rejected with IdentityConflict unless force is true. oneTimePreKeys is a POOL, not per-fetch-consumed the way a stateful prekey server would: aozora's self-sovereign-repo write model has no way for a peer's read (getPrekeyBundle) to also mark one consumed on the publisher's own repo, so an initiator picks one pseudo-randomly from the published pool per session instead of the pool being drawn down one-at-a-time. This is a deliberate, documented deviation from single-use OPKs, not an oversight — see yoro-ui.interop.signal's ns docstring.

identityKey.description: aozora extension: base64url X25519 public identity key

signedPreKey.description: aozora extension: base64url X25519 public signed prekey

signedPreKeySig.description: aozora extension: base64url Ed25519 signature over signedPreKey, signed by the caller's did:key identity key

signedPreKeyId.description: aozora extension: monotonically increasing prekey rotation id

oneTimePreKeys.description: aozora extension: base64url X25519 one-time-prekey pool (public keys). Replaces the previous pool wholesale on every registration (same rotation cadence as signedPreKey). May be omitted/empty — a bundle with no OPKs degrades gracefully to X3DH without OPK (kotoba.signal.x3dh's dh4 is skipped, matching the prior X3DH-lite security level for that specific actor).

force.description: aozora extension: explicitly confirm overwriting a DIFFERENT already-registered identityKey (breaks existing peer sessions with the old identity). Omit/false for normal same-device prekey rotation.
